title: Primary Four English — Term 3
summary: Six 40-minute periods each week: three grammar and three composition/comprehension periods in the school scheme’s order. Detailed generation is limited to weeks 1–2 for this request. Eight reference weeks plus revision complete the ten-week outline.

gaps: The two main school schemes provide eight weeks of detailed pacing. Weeks 9–10 are left for sourced revision and final assessment.

The scheme lists We shall miss Mr Guma and My family but supplies no complete texts for those readings in the pack. Weeks 1–2 instead use complete source texts Akot’s plan, Namata’s work plan and Mukaga’s daily plan, retaining the future/time reading strand.
